evidence.name: Screen field: Auto-renew disclosure styling
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Auto-renew disclosure styling" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Auto-renew disclosure styling
sections.description: Sets the font, size, weight, color, and alignment of the auto-renew disclosure text. Keep it small and quiet relative to your main button — but it must stay clearly readable. App Store and ad-network rules require the renewal terms be legible, so avoid tiny sizes or low-contrast colors that effectively hide the disclosure.
